text:
maria: Night shift here — quick handoff thread. TL;DR: embeddings service saw sustained throttling on dedicated pool B, causing tail latency spikes (~300-500ms extra) for a subset of customers. Mitigations in progress, see below.

maria: What I did: 1) validated alert (high p99 embed latency) and correlated with dedicated-pool-b autoscale events, 2) flipped embed-cache-prefetch to conservative on pool B (temp), 3) rolled back the recent batch-size bump in canary (PR #4123), 4) opened incident ticket INF-2026.

maria: Blockers: can't reproduce locally, metrics show high queue depth on pool B even though GPU util is moderate. suspect an async IO stall on the shard responsible for small requests.

devon: Noted — I saw the same on traces. There are repeated short I/O stalls from ssd-io-03 on shard-7. I've put a maintenance mark on ssd-io-03 in the infra dashboard to avoid new allocations.

alex: Thanks — can you paste the trace id for one of the high-p99 samples? I want to check KV cache hits vs misses.

devon: trace id 0a3f9b2e-7c1 (example). snippet from logs: ```2026-06-10T02:14:22Z shard-7 ssd-io-03 READ 120ms queue=18 ctx=embed.req id=0a3f9b2e-7c1```

maria: Mitigations applied: conservative prefetch & batch rollback rolled out to pool B (all nodes), maintenance mark on ssd-io-03, fallback routing enabled for affected customers to pool C (lower throughput but stable). Monitoring lagging metrics, but tail latency down ~40% in the last 20m.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: rolled back canary batch-size bump (PR #4123) to canary, then promoted to pool B. Deploy ID: deploy-2026-176950. No failures.

sre_lead: Good first response. Next steps: 1) run full disk health check on ssd-io-03 and adjacent nodes, 2) narrow down request-size distribution that triggers stalls, 3) add a runtime flag to disable aggressive prefetch per-shard (low risk). I'll take 1).

maria: Who wants 2)? I'd like to pair with someone to write a quick simulation to replicate queue depth behavior.

alex: I'll take 2). Will start with sampling 1k requests from the window 02:00-03:00 UTC and compare headers. Ping me in DMs if you want to join.

devon: I'll own 3) — adding a flag and a short rollout plan. estimate 2-3 hours.

maria: Outstanding action items: INF-2026 (incident), TKT-890 (disk health + replacement if needed), PR-4150 (runtime flag), PR-4160 (simulation + test harness).

maria: Today (next shift): keep pool B on conservative settings until disk health confirmed, watch queue depth and p99 for customers routed to pool C, and confirm no regression in canary for small embeds. If anything degrades, escalate to sre_lead and open an accelerated maintenance window.

alex: quick note — pinged infra on the storage backup schedule for that rack.

maria: ok thanks team. leaving the channel for now. @sre_lead please ack once you start the disk checks. :thumbsup:
